name: What are the first steps to plan an interior home renovation?

mainEntity.name: What are the first steps to plan an interior home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Begin by defining your goals and vision for the renovation, including desired functionality, aesthetics, and a realistic budget. Research design ideas and gather inspiration. Consider consulting with an architect or designer, especially for complex projects. Obtain professional estimates from contractors, ensuring they understand your scope and expectations. Finally, establish a clear timeline and discuss payment schedules and project milestones with your chosen contractor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start by defining goals, researching designs, budgeting, and getting professional estimates from contractors.
